tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250dgongs gter thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs dang mig 'byed gsal bar byed pa'i gser gyi mig thur zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300a: rtsa gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo:

spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs dang mig 'byed ni: na mo: dkon mchog kun 'dus spyan ras gzigs: bdag dang 'gro kun skyabs su mchi: ma gyur sems can thams cad kun: byang chub thob par sems bskyed do: chos kun mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang: pad dkar zla steng hrīḥyig las: rang nyid 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: dkar gsal chu shel ltar 'tsher ba: zhal gcig phyag bzhi mtshan dpe rdzogs: ral pa'i zur phud 'od dpag brgyan: phyag bzhi dang gnyis bdud rtsi yi: bum pa me long sdig sgrib bkru: lhag gnyis shel phreng pad dkar 'dzin: ri dwags lpags pas nu g.yon bkab: tshangs skud lha rdzas na bzas bklubs: zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: de las 'od 'phros rang 'dra ba'i: ye shes spyan drangs dbyer med gyur: slar yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha: spyan drangs chu rgyun dbang bskur bas: rigs kyi bdag po'i skur thim gyur: thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥyig dkar po la yi ge bdun pa zla ba la rgyu skar gyis bskor ba lta bur bsgom: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: ci nus bzla: mig 'byed sngags: oṃ tsakṣuḥtsakṣuḥpra sha ka swā hā: spro na bris sku bshams pa'i mdun du mchod pa ci 'byor dang: gtor ma bshams la: mdun bskyed gong gi 'don pa cung zad kha bsgyur la: bzlas pa'i gong du mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang: de nas bzlas pa la 'jug: bzlas pa'i mjug tu gtor ma 'bul ba sogs spyi ltar byas na legs par rtogs so: mthar ni snang srid 'phags pa'i skur: gyur pa lhar 'dus rang la thim: de yang thugs srog hrīḥyig la: hrīḥyang mi dmigs ngang du bzhag: dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag: sogs/ shwa lo ka gnyis kyis smon lam btab: de ltar dgongs gter thugs rje chen po'i mig 'byed 'di bzhin snga mor yang yi ger bkod pa byas kyang*/

do gal chung bas zag cing*/ de'i rkyen gyis yun ring bar kun gzhi'i klong nas mi snang bar gyur pa/ gnam chos mi 'gyur rdo rje'i dgongs gter gnam chos sogs 'byung ba'i gnas dang*/ spyan ras gzigs dngos mkhas grub karma chags med kyi gdan sa dpal ri rtse yi khang bzang du dbon sprul karma 'byung gnas kyis yang yang bskul ba ltar/ rig sngags 'chang ba rdo rje drag po 'phrin las 'dus pa rtsal lam/ ming gzhan rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po nus ldan rtsal gyi dgongs pa'i gter las phyung ba shin tu zab pas gces par zungs shig /ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ
